source.contents: csinterview core-concept rewrite (2 questions), /hey morecs, teaching keys with bold spans, enforced giveaway check, morecs 240 s budget, and main up to #22 (GMS usage logging)

approval: User asked to merge and deploy (2026-10-27); compiled code bundle transferred to existing edo1 only
method: Overlay of /app/dist and /app/migrations on the exact prior images (35 runtime modules hash-checked); no dependency, migration, n8n workflow, PostgreSQL or tunnel change

prepare.firstAttempt: stopped in prepare: bundle files were 0600 so the image user could not read the overlay; partial release and unusable image removed before retry, production untouched

verification.controllerHostConfigSame: same settings; only Binds list order differs, identical as a set and identical runtime mounts

publicIngress.note: Generic JSON requests without platform headers get 404 at the edge; the tunnel forwards only ^/webhooks/(github|gitlab)$

liveMrTest.detail: The user posted the /hey commands on their own MR and reported that it works. This session did not observe the comments or jobs (its read-only watcher was stopped at the user's request before any command completed), so no live command output is recorded here.

rollback.effect: compatible prior controller + exact prior runner; data kept; /hey morecs unavailable
rollback.currentValidity: Superseded: change-fa9b7c8 (PR #24, another session) was activated on top of this pair shortly after; its rollback returns to this pair first. This release's rollback refuses while compose.json differs from its candidate.
